correctness.rationale: Stationary covariance S solves (γI+mL)S+S(γI+mL)=Q, so S(0)=Q/(2γ), S′(0)=−(LQ+QL)/(4γ²). Differentiating Pearson r gives the stated general path expression. In Qδ, q11=2+δ,q33=17+δ,q12=q23=1,q13=5; the slope numerator 2δ²+28δ−27 has exactly one positive root. Laplacian modal decomposition leaves only consensus variance at m→∞, giving r→1; continuity gives finite positive minimizer for δ below threshold. The δ=1/4 closed-form correlation K/sqrt(AC) has strictly positive A,C,K; derivative numerator polynomial has coefficients −,−,+,…,+, hence exactly one positive root by Descartes and endpoint signs, bracketed by exact rationals. Two-patch derivative = (a+b)(ab−c²)/(2γ(ab)^(3/2))>0. Independently verified symbolic derivative, degree-13 polynomial and bracket.

final_claim: For path-3 OU dynamics with common damping γ and SPD increment covariance Q, endpoint Pearson r′(0)=[q12(1−q13/q11)+q23(1−q13/q33)]/[2γ√(q11 q33)]. For Qδ=11ᵀ+(1,0,4)(1,0,4)ᵀ+δI (δ>0), the exact sign threshold is δc=(5√10−14)/2; below it correlation initially decreases yet tends to one at high dispersal. At δ=1/4 the positive minimizer is unique and t=m/γ∈(7967,7968)/1e5. All SPD 2-patch models with equal damping have positive initial correlation slope.
